{{Top|leg}}
A '''flophouse''' was a type of low-market hotel. They could be found in run-down and rough places, like the lower levels of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].

==Locations==
*[[Nar Shaddaa Docks]]
*[[Gnawer's Roost]] district of Coruscant.
